title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review: Singapore's Long-Running Women-Only Race
seo_title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review | Singapore
meta_description: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 review: November 1 at Singapore National Stadium -- a women-only race with five categories from 100m to half marathon.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 with a 4:30am start at Singapore's National Stadium in The Kallang, this women-only race spans five categories -- from a symbolic 100m dash up to the full 21.1K half marathon.
verdict: The Great Eastern Women's Run is a genuinely distinctive event on gender-focused format alone -- a women-only race, backed by insurer Great Eastern, running at Singapore's National Stadium in The Kallang, the country's premier sports and entertainment district. Five categories spanning from a symbolic 100m dash to the 21.1K half marathon give it an unusually broad, inclusive range, likely designed to welcome first-time participants alongside serious half-marathoners. The 4:30am start reflects standard tropical heat management. Registration is currently open.

sections.heading: A Women-Only Race With Five Categories
paragraphs: The Great Eastern Women's Run offers five distances -- 0.1K (100m), 2K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K -- starting at 4:30am from Singapore's National Stadium in The Kallang. [1] The event is specifically for women runners, backed by Great Eastern, a major Southeast Asian insurance company -- a distinctive brand and format combination compared to the general-audience races dominating most of this research batch.

sections.heading: Starting at Singapore's Premier Sports District
paragraphs: The National Stadium opened in 2014 on the site of the former National Stadium (1973-2010), forming the centrepiece of The Kallang -- a sports, entertainment and recreation district that also includes the Singapore Indoor Stadium, OCBC Aquatic Centre and OCBC Arena. [2] The 55,000-seat stadium features one of the largest domed structures in the world, with a naturally ventilated design and retractable roof.

sections.heading: An Unusually Inclusive Distance Spread
paragraphs: The inclusion of a symbolic 100m category alongside the standard 2K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K distances is genuinely unusual -- most races in this research batch stop at a 3K or 5K minimum. [1] That range suggests a deliberate design to welcome complete beginners or families alongside serious half-marathon competitors, all under one women-focused event umbrella.

sections.heading: An Early Start for Tropical Conditions
paragraphs: The 4:30am gun time reflects standard heat management for a Singapore road race, similar to the early starts seen across most tropical Southeast Asian events in this research batch. [1] Registration is currently open.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a women-only race with genuinely broad distance inclusivity at one of Singapore's most prestigious sports venues appeals, the Great Eastern Women's Run on 1 November 2026 is a strong pick -- especially for first-time participants drawn in by the shorter symbolic categories. Registration is open now.
